svg.title: Tangent and normal to a curve
svg.desc: For y=3x^2−4sqrt(x), at x=4 the point is (4,40), tangent gradient 23, tangent y=23x−52, and normal x+23y−924=0.

g.text: Tangent and normal to a curve
Pearson Edexcel International A Level Mathematics • Differentiation
At x = 4, differentiate first, then use the point (4, 40).
